source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    period = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        starts = [((value - 1 - c) % period) + 1
                  for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
        start = Counter(starts).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 0:
                out[r][c] = ((start - 1 + c) % period) + 1
    return out
